name: curiosity
description: Desire to keep watching to discover what happens or how a promise is fulfilled.

name: identification
description: Feeling of "this person understands my reality and speaks to me".

name: understanding
description: Clear mental comprehension of how an offer, space, or process operates.

name: belief
description: Cognitive acceptance that a claim is authentic, factual, and attainable.

name: trust
description: Emotional security and confidence in the presenter, developer, or agency.

name: desire
description: Aspirational longing to inhabit the space or own the lifestyle portrayed.

name: surprise
description: Unexpected revelation or pleasant counter-intuitive insight.

name: relief
description: Alleviation of financial anxiety, spatial frustration, or bureaucratic fear.

name: urgency
description: Recognition of limited opportunity or timing advantage requiring action.

name: value_perception
description: Recognition that the property delivers immense value relative to its cost.

name: spatial_understanding
description: Mental 3D map of floorplan flow, room dimensions, and integration.

name: memorability
description: Key figures, unique amenities, or emotional phrases retained in memory.

name: action_readiness
description: Preparedness to tap the screen, send a lead, or book a site visit.

name: anticipation_payoff
description: Pleasurable fulfillment of a setup or curiosity gap previously built.

name: orientation
description: Clear grounding in where we are geographically, physically, and narratively.

name: curiosity_resolution
description: Resolution of an open question posed earlier in the video.
